title: Source coverage and native reader: four complete records with exact semantic/runtime limits

reviews.classification: complete bounded source-coverage or native-reader owner; source/runtime evidence remains separate
reviews.disposition: All13 original lines were reviewed. Keep the finite21-root semantic pass separate from structural EOF/field-order validation, enumerated flags and recovered method bodies. The specific legacy, XP, death, hunger/terror and port consumers were selected reading, not every facet, victory, relationship or quest-reset rule. The unread main-config interval and resources remain exact source gaps; normal save hydration, crash/atomicity, combat and platform behavior were not exercised. Developer text and installed method/table disagreement stays attributed rather than silently resolved as current runtime. Manifest/depot presence does not establish entitlement or exclude bundled updates. Private retention totals are the recorded extraction scope, not current disk state. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) and AD32/AD36 govern any selected consumer. This review did not read retained binary/source artifacts, fetch commentary, launch the game, inspect personal saves or rerun recovery. Preserve the no-launch boundary of the original assignment; reading this coverage record authorizes no runtime or acquisition operation.
reviews.evidence: Complete13-line input read, every coverage row; original source artifacts and linked findings not read by proxy.
reviews.reopen: For an authorized named mechanic recover exact retained body/table/claim and consumer; current installation/license/runtime state remains unverified.

reviews.classification: complete bounded source-coverage or native-reader owner; source/runtime evidence remains separate
reviews.disposition: The complete15-line coverage record distinguishes targeted inheritance/death/family/hunger/terror reading and named managed bodies from exported classes and structurally parsed event/quality tables. “Every narrative row” in the unread list means exhaustive coverage is absent; it does not erase the selected rows already read. Unity Resources and embedded tables have different provenance, and the declared loader/override path is not proof of a user's hydrated current state. DLC depot/content/code presence is separate from entitlement, activation and complete submerged-story coverage. Historical developer feedback is not an independent player-consensus survey. Keep map/discovery, serialization, override, combat and runtime gaps rather than advertising source recovery as playable behavior or an authored YAIR slice. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) and AD32/AD36 govern follow-up. No original extracted tables, code bodies, install, settings, player save, game launch or runtime path was newly inspected; prior cleanup/removal statements are history, not an instruction to remove anything now.

reviews.classification: complete bounded source-coverage or native-reader owner; source/runtime evidence remains separate
reviews.disposition: All23 lines and every area row were read. Inventory/search of112962 nodes differs from complete text/script reading of five selected conversations, selected excerpts and actual branch execution. The53 thought summaries and effect arrays are structurally decoded evidence; opaque tail/quip fields and unread benefit consumers remain gaps. Seventeen bounded x86_64 bodies do not establish ARM parity or full native decompilation; shared generic aliases can misname calls. Signatures and state fields are not a save roundtrip. C8–C9 retain contradictory source numbers; stronger serialized configuration does not eliminate possible initialization/override uncertainty without the actual consumer. Soundtrack/artbook depot paths are inventory, not gameplay DLC or entitlement. UI fields and individual discussion reports establish neither rendered accessibility nor a consensus/RNG defect. Eight YAIR proposals remain proposals. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) and AD32/AD36 govern actual adoption. This review did not open private dialogue/native artifacts, original discussion/developer sources, audio/art, player saves or gameplay, and supplies no new whole-game/source-fidelity claim.

reviews.classification: complete bounded source-coverage or native-reader owner; source/runtime evidence remains separate
reviews.disposition: The complete21-line reader guide was reviewed as an operational locator, not a new recovery run. Its update/find/extract/summary/reconcile commands describe private indexed artifacts; illustrative addresses, retained sessions and installed build/tool versions are dated, not current verified handles or commands executed here. Ghidra C-like output and inferred types differ from original C++; hashes/counts, call references, vtable reachability and actual runtime calls are distinct evidence. Keep callable-candidate, generated-function, thunk/import, external-library and both-architecture denominators separate, including the71 additional anonymous arm64 starts and noncallable Mach-O header exclusion at the recorded inventory. Initial38-body reading, later entry/hash retries and excluded assertion tails retain their individual source identities. Native symbols do not establish Lua/DLC source coverage; preserved Steam API/license material does not mean those external bodies were recovered or executed. The [checkpoint](CHECKPOINT.md) owns later progress. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md) and AD32/AD36 govern any selected adoption. No private database/chunk, binary, source binding, installed tool/game, license or personal save was read or executed by this reconciliation.
